body: The ocean and atmosphere exchange energy and matter across their boundary. Winds can drive surface currents. Differences in water temperature and salinity affect density and help drive deeper movements. Currents redistribute heat across an otherwise unevenly heated planet.

When water evaporates, it takes energy from its surroundings. Water vapor carries this energy and can release energy during condensation. Observing wind, surface temperature and humidity together helps investigators estimate exchanges that cannot be read from a single photograph.
credit: Centauri Archive editorial draft, written with AI assistance
limitations: Ocean and atmosphere interactions occur at different time and length scales. Currents and individual cloud patterns can vary with depth, season and location.
purpose: Show why air and seawater circulation affect one another and redistribute heat.
